items.author: trevorsideas.bsky.social
items.context: GoG Galaxy is coming to Linux. I know that's been requested heavily so that's nice to hear as well. Only other announcement that caught my attention is a GoG Social platform for discussing games. Yet another social media? Ugh... I don't know...
items.text: Galaxy on Linux is a big one for people who asked for it. GOG games are DRM-free anyway, so you can keep the installer and run them without the launcher too.
items.verify: Проверьте: GOG Galaxy для Linux действительно анонсирован (так написано в посте автора).
